summary.text: Michael J. Jones is a Democratic member of the Virginia Senate, representing District 15, which covers parts of Chesterfield County and Richmond City, and has served in the Senate since 2026.
Jones sits on the Senate committees on Courts of Justice; Privileges and Elections; Rehabilitation and Social Services; and Transportation.

paragraphs.text: Michael J. Jones was born in Portsmouth, Virginia on July 14, 1967, according to the Senate profile.
The profile lists Jones's education as University of Colorado, Boulder (B.A. Sociology); McCormick Theological Seminary, Chicago, Illinois (MDiv); and Virginia Union University (D.D.).
The profile gives Jones's occupation as pastor.
Michael J. Jones was a member of the House of Delegates from 2024-2026, according to the profile.
